message.jemcompat.ender_eye_locator_only: The ordinary Eye of Ender is a reusable locator. Only the twelve campaign Eyes fit this frame.
message.jemcompat.non_campaign_eye: This Eye is not part of the twelve and cannot activate the portal.
message.jemcompat.map_not_found: No matching structure was found nearby. Try again from another region.
message.jemcompat.map_search_active: A boss structure search is already running.
message.jemcompat.map_search_failed: The boss structure search could not be completed.
message.jemcompat.map_requires_nether: Bro, go to the Nether first. This locator only works there.
message.jemcompat.xaero_unavailable: Xaero World Map is not ready yet.
tooltip.jemcompat.boss_locator.use: Use to locate the exact encounter and open it in Xaero World Map.
message.jemcompat.campaign.prerequisite_: %s defeated. The Eye is earned from %s.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.dune_sen: Search desert regions and ancient ruins for the Dune Sentinel.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.mummy: Search desert regions and buried tombs for a Mummy.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.golden_h: Search warm sandy shores and arid regions for the Golden Hermit King.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.ancient_: Search old surface ruins for the Ancient Guardian.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.bone_sta: Search dark forests and wilderness at night for a Bone Stalker.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.overgrow: Search dense green wilderness and ancient overgrown ruins for the Overgrown Colossus.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.captain_: Search frozen oceans and their ice mazes for Captain Cornelia. Nature's Compass can lead you to a frozen ocean.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.sea_vipe: Search open oceans and coastal waters for a Sea Viper.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.skor: Search snowy mountains and the hidden Yeti lair for Skor. Nature's Compass can lead you to the mountains.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.frostbit: Search snowy regions and their frozen temples for the Frostbitten Golem. Nature's Compass can lead you to the right climate.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.yeti: Search snowy wilderness for a Yeti. Nature's Compass can lead you to the right climate.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.withered: Search the Nether's soul-haunted regions and ruined strongholds for the Withered Abomination.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.lava_eat: Search the hottest lava-filled regions of the Nether for the Lava Eater.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.piglin_e: Search the Nether's piglin territories and beast pits for the Piglin Executioner.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.furnace: Search scorched Nether regions for the Furnace.
message.jemcompat.campaign.hint.skeletos: Search the Nether's soul sand valleys and ancient nests for the Skeletosaurus.
advancement.jemcompat.story.title: The Twelve Climax Encounters
advancement.jemcompat.story.description: Complete twelve visible boss branches and claim their Eyes.
advancement.jemcompat.prerequisite.capta: Defeat the Ghost of Captain Cornelia.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.ancient_rem: Defeat the Ancient Remnant and claim the Old Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.possessed_p: Defeat the Possessed Paladin and claim the Corrupted Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.leviathan.d: Defeat the Leviathan and claim the Guardian Eye.
Defeat Maledictus and claim the Cold Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.sirok.title: Sirok
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.sirok.descr: Defeat Sirok and claim the Black Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.luxtructosa: Defeat the Luxtructosaurus and claim the Exotic Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.cumulonimbu: Defeat Cumulonimbus and claim the Magical Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.netherite_m: Defeat the Netherite Monstrosity and claim the Nether Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.harbinger.d: Defeat the Harbinger and claim the Lost Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.scylla.desc: Defeat Scylla and claim the Cursed Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.infernal_dr: Defeat Ashlord and claim the Wither Eye.
advancement.jemcompat.defeat.helvar.desc: Defeat Helvar and claim the Undead Eye.
quest.jemcompat.collect.title: Claim All Twelve Eyes
quest.jemcompat.collect.desc: Each first qualifying MAIN-boss victory awards one protected Eye. Sneak-use an empty End Portal Frame to recover an earned Eye that is missing.
quest.jemcompat.portal.title: Open the End Portal
quest.jemcompat.portal.desc: Ordinary Eyes of Ender locate the Stronghold and never shatter. Place the twelve distinct campaign Eyes into the portal frames.
